contentSection.heading: Our Product

items.description: Glass Finish Cabin is a design created to reflect your Building Richness.

The Glass Door Cabin is the epitome of modern elevator design, combining functionality with striking aesthetics. Crafted to offer a clear, panoramic view, this model brings openness and luxury to both commercial and residential buildings. It’s ideal for spaces where design, visibility, and user experience go hand in hand.

This marvelleous model comes with a complete Glass Finish Car Enclosure with a False Ceiling fitted with Blower for a cooling effect inside the Car. The Glass Finish Cabin comes with Fully Automatic Doors available in both Centre Opening or Telescopic doors.

contentSection.heading7: Modern Design with a Panoramic Experience
contentSection.description: Engineered with toughened safety glass and framed with sleek stainless steel finishes, the Glass Door Cabin offers a spacious, sophisticated look. Ideal for malls, apartments, corporate buildings, or luxury homes, it provides a unique visual connection to the environment outside.

items3.text: Panoramic view offering a spacious, elegant look
Ideal for malls, apartments, offices, and luxury homes
Toughened safety glass with sleek stainless steel framing
Automatic doors in transparent or frosted glass options
False ceiling with LED lighting and blower for comfort

contentSection.description2: Despite its open appearance, the Glass Door Cabin is built for maximum safety and performance. Equipped with electronic door safety, high-resolution plasma displays inside the car, and LED indicators on each floor, it offers an intelligent and seamless user experience.

items4.text: Electronic door safety and plasma display
Clear panels for a spacious feel
Optional tinted glass and designer handles
